script: I finally stopped yelling at reckless drivers—then they did something I never saw coming.. I was cruising down the freeway when this idiot cut through every lane like they owned the road. They'd waited too long to pass, then just barreled from left to right, endangering everyone. Naturally, I'd have snapped, shoved my hand up, and yelled, "What the heck?" They'd flip me off, and both of us would be in a bad mood for the rest of the drive. I decided to switch tactics. I rolled up beside the reckless driver, stared straight into their eyes, and flashed the usual furious glare. Then, in that exact moment, I shifted my expression to a calm "Ohhhh! Okay, THAT makes sense. Sorry!" I added a tiny smile and a wave, and then I was off. The look on their face? Priceless. They'd freeze, then crack a grin, or just look baffled. And I felt way cooler, like I'd dodged a storm instead of getting soaked. Trust me, give it a try. It's a game changer.
